manifest.name: ZELTAR — Free Racing Preview
manifest.description: All Things Gamed presents ZELTAR: a free solo time trial. Choose COMET or VIPER (clearly labeled visual-preview models), customize free paint, lights and fins, then race three laps through 36 ordered checkpoints. WASD/arrows drive, Shift boosts, Space launches, R retries, B returns to the Lab. Barrier hits add one second; higher points win. No purchases, prizes or multiplayer racing.

credits.work: Original ZelPods, ZEL Towers architecture, ZELTAR interface, course and sounds
